prompt: Build an Appmixer flow: when the app event "new-user" arrives (example data: {"email": "john@example.com"}), store the email in a variable named userEmail.
Build an Appmixer flow that every day at 9:00 UTC performs an HTTP GET request to https://example.com/health.

Build an Appmixer flow: on app event "order" (example data: {"amount": 250, "customer": "ACME"}), if the amount is greater than 1000, set a variable bigOrder with the customer name; otherwise set a variable smallOrder with the customer name.
Build an Appmixer flow: on app event "message" (example data: {"text": "hello world"}), set a variable textLength containing the number of characters of the text field.
Build an Appmixer flow that exposes a webhook; when the webhook receives a request, respond to the caller with a JSON body {"status": "received"}.

Build an Appmixer flow: on app event "ping" (example data: {"msg": "hi"}), first set a variable original with the msg value, then in a second, separate step set another variable copy with the same msg value. The two steps must be two chained components.

Build an Appmixer flow: every 60 minutes perform an HTTP GET to https://example.com/api. Configure the HTTP step so that when it fails, it does NOT auto-retry and routes the error to its error port, where a variable failureMessage is set to the error message.
Build an Appmixer flow: on app event "batch" (example data: {"items": ["a", "b"]}), iterate over the items array and for each item set a variable currentItem with the item value.
Build an Appmixer flow: on app event "signup" (example data: {"email": "jane@company.com"}), only when the email contains "@company.com", set a variable companySignup with the email.

Build an Appmixer flow: on app event "weather" (example data: {"temp": 21, "city": "Prague"}), set a variable report with the text "Temperature in <city>: <temp> C" where <city> and <temp> come from the event data.
